title: A home for GSoC 2026 contributors
summary:
A GSoC contributor hub, image-generation groundwork, and a new entry tier led the day; news copy and MCP model listings got tidied up too.

A GSoC app was added with project ideas, mentor profiles, a timeline, application guidance, FAQs, and an assistant for contributor questions. The ideas range from gaming SDKs and a CLI to a platform health agent and multimodal semantic cache.

A TwinFlow-Z-Image-Turbo server was added with aspect-ratio-preserving scaling up to 1280×1280 pixels and a five-step default. Flux Schnell’s GPU setup was also updated for RTX 5090 hardware.

Microbe was added to the tier configuration at 0.1 Pollen per day. Enter’s tier panel and the Hello page now show five tiers, with Microbe described as the entry tier and Spore as verified. Signup and verification logic did not change.

highlights.title: GSoC ideas take shape
highlights.text: Explore GSoC 2026 project ideas, mentor profiles, application guidance, and a contributor Q&A assistant in the new GSoC app.
